references.text: About keeping promises to the Lord - what comes out of your lips you must keep and do
Warns against making vows to God without fulfilling them - better not to promise than to promise and fail to keep it
Encouragement to fulfill vows made to the Most High
The psalmist promises to enter God's house with burnt offerings and fulfill his vows
Encouragement to make vows to the Lord your God and keep them
Warning against rushing to dedicate something to the Lord and only later reflecting on the vows
Jesus teaches about keeping oaths and vows made to the Lord
